final_release_installer.window: Walked in front on the maintainer's screen with the maintainer's agreement, from the unmodified copy, with HOME, HF_APP_DIR and HF_CONFIG_DIR pointing at a scratch folder and a copy of the desktop app's provider configuration (DeepSeek), deleted afterwards. The window showed oxfuzz v0.9.13 with the full sidebar. A project folder holding the picinfo sample (an aarch64 file reader with a planted fault) was opened through the folder dialog. The Binary view read picinfo without running it (aarch64, dynamically linked, 69.2 KiB, 19 imports) and suggested the file-argument mode with its reason. Draft seeds returned 8 model-proposed seeds, which were then used; Refine with AI reduced the dictionary to PIC1. With CompCov on (the default) and persistent mode on main, pressing Start session ran a one-minute session: 501,794 executions at 8,361 per second, 100% stability, one distinct finding, a SEGV at target+0xcbc confirmed by replay. The crashing input the fuzzer kept was already 8 bytes, which the fault needs, so minimization found nothing smaller and none was kept. The Triage view listed the binary session and its finding with four stack frames, and Explain with AI returned a note naming a null or near-null pointer dereference through x22 at ldrb w2, [x22, x0], with the disassembly sent shown beside it. A first attempt at this walk showed an unpainted window because the scratch HOME folder did not exist; the same copy painted normally once it did, as did a launch with an existing HOME, so the blank window came from the test setup.
